comments.text:
Sne takes two midterms, counts the best 2 out of 3 quizzes, and has a group report and presentation along with a group case study which was quite easy. During my time, she also gave a 3 mark bonus question. She is a bit strict when it comes to presentations and expects you to be properly prepared, but overall she is very supportive. I had an issue with my group during the course, and she solved the issue fairly.
She is also very transparent with grading. She calls everyone to her office and shows them the complete breakdown of the marks they received. I think she probably curved the whole class according to the overall class performance. You definitely do not need to oil her. In fact, she does not seem to like oiling at all. You can ask genuine questions if you actually need clarification, but avoid asking unnecessary questions just for the sake of it. Also avoid making unnecessary jokes during class if you want to stay on her good side.
For the exams, if you actually understand the topics, it is quite easy to do well. Her mcqs and written questions are not heavily focused on memorising specific answers, so understanding the concepts is enough to perform well. I personally did well in the course without having to study excessively. Overall, I had a really positive experience with her.

FACULTY REVIEW
Course Code: LAW200
Faculty Name: Tasnuva Tabassum Ratry miss
Faculty Initial: TTR
Before starting law200, all my friends and seniors had me known that it is an easy course. But an easy course can absolutely turn to a nightmare course if the faculty is not easy going, friendly, helpful and warm. TTR miss is absolutely all the adjectives I mentioned above. She will go over and above to ensure you understood the topic and do not have any unanswered questions. She will address your queries on spot, reiterated again, as she will not even instruct you to visit her office or mail her. In the one-on-one conversation on that very moment she will clear your confusion and throughout your duration with her, she will maintain a friendly demeanour with you.
Needless to say, law study material is not just another PPT slide and you may already know there are even individual books on individual topics in the contemporary law fields. With miss's study slides, you can understand for a little bit of what it feels like to step into the shoes of our very own law department students if you are not from the law department itself, albeit for a semester even though they are studying for the degree itself. But miss's aim is not to overwhelm you or put you in a simulated environment, but to teach you or bring to your knowledge these particular elements of law and how they can be used on business fields. She will provide a big number of study materials, and I mean big, but she will not leave you alone with them and will guide you with proper justice throughout the complexities.
2 mids, 2 quizzes, 1 final and 1 presentation consisted of miss's teaching structure. She will ask easy and straightforward questions from the slides. Make sure you have a sound idea about the topics and the course will be much go much more smoother than you anticipated.
Miss will give you a lot, teach you a lot, will make you study a lot but will also mark you a lot. I will be forever thankful to miss for not making this course anymore difficult than it needed to be, and you will be very fortunate if you take law200 with TTR miss.
